description.value:
Your Transmuter's Stone becomes more versatile. When you create it, you can choose up to two benefits; you can choose each option other than Resistance only once, and if you choose Resistance twice, you must choose different damage types. You can change either or both benefits when you cast a Transmutation spell using a spell slot.

In addition, the following are now among the benefit options of your Transmuter's Stone.

Mighty Build. The bearer has Advantage on Strength saving throws and counts as one size larger when determining its carrying capacity.

Tremorsense. The bearer gains Tremorsense with a range of 30 feet.
